geometry: A hand-drawn curved ring with angular lower ends and a central vertical bar; the right half uses 45% opacity. The source canvas is 20 by 20 pixels, with visible artwork approximately x=1–19 and y=2–18 and a central bar about 2 pixels wide.
limitations: The curved ring and small lower notches are approximations of the antialiased source; the enlarged SVG rendering was visually inspected. Position and scale were tuned against the original; the updated 8x rendering was inspected.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
